'''Tolamyn Cayble''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A clever and confident intelligence operative, Cayble had a good field record and he was responsible for the elimination of several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] factions in the Elrood [[Sector/Legends|sector]], keeping Rebel activity in the region to a minimum. After the Rebel agent [[Shondra Del]] attempted to broker an alliance between the Rebels and the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, Cayble oversaw an operation that resulted in her capture. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] afterward, Cayble and his fellow ISB agent [[Dineas D' Ink]] directed an Imperial raid on [[Friends of Paran base|the base]] of the [[Friends of Paran]] resistance group in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Knellis]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. In the aftermath of the attack, Cayble feared that the resistance group would attempt to sabotage the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]], so he sent thirty ISB agents to defend the installation.
